fields.value: SmartNIC optimizations include importance-based boundary node sampling, where nodes with more edges to the local subgraph receive predicted embeddings and the rest use historical embeddings, controlled by sampling_ratio. They also include an asynchronous pipeline that skips boundary-node communication in Stale Epochs and has the GPU send fresh embeddings to the DPU during Sync Epochs. A third optimization reuses intermediate results via decayed trend accumulators and self-feeding of predicted values into ring buffers.
Measured overhead reductions from each optimization are not reported in these chunks.
